name: Heat wave
advice: Stay indoors 12-4 pm, drink water, check on elderly people.

name: Very hot day
advice: Avoid outdoor work in the afternoon and stay hydrated.

name: Cold wave
advice: Wear warm layers; protect children and the elderly at night.

name: Heavy rain
advice: Expect waterlogging; avoid low-lying roads and plan travel early.

name: Strong winds
advice: Secure loose objects; be careful with two-wheelers.

name: Very high UV
advice: Use sunscreen and avoid direct sun around noon.

name: Unhealthy air
advice: Limit outdoor exercise; wear an N95 mask outside.

name: Hazardous air
advice: Stay indoors with windows closed; use an air purifier if possible.

name: Dense fog
advice: Drive slowly with low-beam lights; expect flight and train delays.
